summary: LumenRadio AB (publ), a technology company, provides wireless technology in Sweden. It offers wireless DMX, such as CRMX products, CRMX OEM modules, CRMX software, and accessories DMX; W-DALI, including devices, starter guide, evaluation kit, OEM module, and accessories; and AirGlow comprising Zhaga Book 18, OEM module, and development kit. The company also provides wireless mesh consisting of Mira software, OEM modules, and development kits; and W-Modbus and W-BACnet, which include devices, evaluation and solar kits, OEM modules, development kit, and accessories. Its products are used in entertainment lighting, theater lightning, indoor lightning, street lightning, architectural lightning, HVAC and building control, solar installations, and industrial IoT applications. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.
